journal: PhD thesis, Heriot-Watt University (https://www.ros.hw.ac.uk/handle/10399/3409): Phase equilibria measurements and modelling of CO2-rich fluids/brine systems
experimental_method: Water content of the gas-rich (or liquid-CO2-rich) phase sampled at constant cell pressure: T <= 25 C (Tables 4.2-4.6) rocking titanium cell + heated line to a Yokogawa TDLAS (tunable diode laser absorption spectrometer); T >= 50 C (Tables 4.7, 4.13, 4.15, 4.16) titanium piston cell in a Chandler PVT oven + heated line/valve to an HP 5890 GC (TCD for water). No table extracted here used the chilled-mirror hygrometer (that was used only for the SYNGAS 'CM' rows of Tables 4.9-4.10, not extracted).
uncertainties_stated: T +-0.1 C (both rigs); P +-0.4 bar (Tables 4.4-4.6), +-0.7 bar (Tables 4.7, 4.13); not printed for 4.2/4.3/4.15/4.16 (strain gauge transducer checked against a dead weight tester). Low-T water content: +-1 % of reading or 4 ppm, whichever is greater (TDLAS, stated accuracy +-1 % of reading). High-T GC: per-point relative uncertainties printed in Tables 4.7, 4.15, 4.16; none printed in 4.13.
quality_remarks: 1) The ppm basis is printed as 'y_w - ppm' (4.4-4.6, y_w = water mole fraction) and 'y_w - ppmV' (4.7); Tables 4.2, 4.3, 4.13, 4.15, 4.16 print only 'ppm' and are mapped with unit ppm_basis_not_stated_water_in_gas (builder holds them). Evidence for a mole basis: same TDLAS rig as 4.4-4.6 (for 4.2/4.3) and same GC rig as 4.7, GC calibrated in number of moles (for 4.13/4.15/4.16). Coordinator to decide. 2) Hydrate: Tables 4.2/4.3 label rows VLE or VHE from a CALCULATED methane hydrate dissociation pressure; VHE rows get regime hydrate. The thesis footnote defines VHE as 'Vapour-Liquid-Hydrate Equilibrium' while the text says methane is 'in equilibrium with hydrate'. Tables 4.4-4.6: all points stated to lie below the authors' calculated hydrate dissociation pressure (printed per temperature block; e.g. 15 C / 10 wt% NaCl: 1300.326 bar). 3) Rows above the pure-CO2 vapour pressure at 0-25 C are liquid CO2 (regime lle), consistent with the jump in printed water content. 4) Rows below 273.15 K kept: 4.2 (-5 C), 4.3 (-20, -40 C, all VHE), 4.6 (-5 C, 20 wt% NaCl brine, liquid). 5) Minor oddities as printed: Table 4.4 25 C and Table 4.5 25 C water contents rise slightly with P in the vapour region (1100->1107, 968->970); Table 4.3 -40 C values are non-monotonic (1.7 at 101 bar, 2.8, 3.3 above), within the stated 4 ppm floor; Table 4.6 0 C rows printed out of pressure order (22.19 then 20.32 bar); Table 4.6 5 C first value printed with two decimals (494.19). 6) The authors note the measured liquid-CO2 brine data deviate considerably from their models and argue the data are correct (p.157). 7) The CO2 solubility tables of this thesis are already in GasBrineBench as TEYMOURI(2017); this folder holds only gas-phase water content.

ascii_changes: Degree sign written as 'C'; '+-' for the printed plus-minus; the subscript header 'y_w' written as 'y_w'; printed '%' and '+-' on uncertainty/deviation entries moved into the column header (e.g. '+-2.00%' -> header 'y_w uncertainty +- %', cell '2.00'; '27.28%' -> header 'Deviation CPA %', cell '27.28'). AAD summary values written into the AAD label row text (4.4-4.7) or into the deviation columns (4.2, 4.3, 4.13, 4.15, 4.16).
extraction_notes: Text layer (Word-generated PDF) is clean; cells transcribed from pdftotext -layout into a script and every cell checked against 250 dpi page images (pdftoppm -r 250): all numbers matched, no corrections. Side-by-side temperature blocks of 4.4-4.7 are stacked left to right, each with a label row (T, plus the authors' calculated hydrate dissociation pressure in 4.4-4.6) and an AAD summary row, both in skip_rows. LLE row flags use pure-CO2 vapour pressures (approx. Span-Wagner values) and are confirmed by the step in printed water content. Pressure basis 'total' = equilibrium cell pressure; absolute vs gauge not stated anywhere. Temperature scale not stated. NaCl given as wt% (mass percent of solution assumed by the label '10 wt% NaCl aqueous solution'; the thesis does not define it further). The task note said the low-T CO2-brine data were chilled-mirror dew points; the thesis says TDLAS (p.141-144).
